'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello. You know, a few days ago I caught myself thinking that Tarkov had somehow become... quieter. At least for me. Then yesterday I realized that feeling was misleading. Someone's been deliberately jamming signals in my area of operation. I don't like it, but I don't want to scare them off just yet. You understand why, they could always come back with something more sophisticated. So first I'm going to try a little trick to work around the jammers without alerting whoever's behind them. To do that, I'll need a few components... Here's the list.}}

==Objectives==
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: [[PC CPU]]
* Hand over the [[PC CPU|item]]
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: [[Rechargeable battery]]
* Hand over the [[Rechargeable battery|item]]
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: [[Printed circuit board]]
* Hand over the [[Printed circuit board|item]]
